description: Implementation of QpackProgressiveDecoder class for decoding QPACK header blocks in QUIC protocol, including methods for decoding instructions, handling errors, and managing header table references.

classes.name: QpackProgressiveDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for processing QPACK header blocks, managing decoding state, handling instructions, and error conditions.

methods.name: QpackProgressiveDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with stream ID, enforcer, visitor, header table, and handler.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Main method to decode incoming data stream.

methods.name: EndHeaderBlock
methods.description: Marks end of header block decoding.

methods.name: OnInstructionDecoded
methods.description: Handles decoded instructions and dispatches to specific handlers.

methods.name: OnInsertCountReachedThreshold
methods.description: Handles threshold event for insert count, unblocking stream.

methods.name: DoIndexedHeaderFieldPostBaseInstruction
methods.description: Processes post-base indexed header field instruction.

methods.name: DoLiteralHeaderFieldNameReferenceInstruction
methods.description: Processes literal header field with name reference instruction.

methods.name: DoLiteralHeaderFieldPostBaseInstruction
methods.description: Processes literal header field with post-base index.

methods.name: DoPrefixInstruction
methods.description: Processes prefix instruction, decoding required insert count and base.

methods.name: OnHeaderDecoded
methods.description: Callback for when a header is decoded successfully.

methods.name: FinishDecoding
methods.description: Finalizes decoding, checks for completeness, and notifies visitor and handler.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles errors, sets error state, and notifies handler.

methods.name: DeltaBaseToBase
methods.description: Calculates base value from delta, considering sign.
